c: The relief that existed before too, became more accentuated, having volume and consistency.
def: Relief is a sculptural method in which the sculpted pieces remain attached to a solid background of the same material.

c: Mansart was the first architect to introduce Baroque styling, principally the frequent use of an applied order and heavy rustication, into the French architectural vocabulary.
def: An order in architecture is a certain assemblage of parts subject to uniform established proportions, regulated by the office that each part has to perform.
